reason: I've already paid for a DM tool that got me almost no replies and an action block, and this still sends DMs from my own account. Nothing here shows it books calls: no reviews, no case studies, and 7 founding seats taken is nothing to go on.
objection: There are no results published, so how do I know it books calls and doesn't get my account blocked again? Three days isn't long enough to find out, and the card is already on file when it starts billing.
would_change_my_mind: Named case studies from coaches like me, with real reply and booked-call numbers and how many DMs they sent. Or a longer trial, or a money-back window after the first month.
